assignment.rule: persistent, by user: bucket = first 7 hex digits of md5(user_id || ':northfield_coffee_cart_abandon_1h') mod 100; bucket < 10 is the holdout, added as in_holdout to the live checkout_started event by the system that sends it; holdout members enter, then exit at holdout_split, so both arms are the same population

primary_metric.description: placed an order (order_completed) within 10 days of entry, treatment vs holdout, both arms counted from their entry date
